CutScene.Text: The journey into Kelthurax’s lair took many hours, and upon arrival, the ancient creature was already awake.
Its piercing gaze never faltered as it accepted the Dragonstone and finally it spoke:
“You seek answers about the Sundering – answers that only I can give you. And give them to you I shall! But you must pay a price.”
“Bring to me the treasures from the Dwarven Halls of Khaz-Agar, and I shall tell you of the Sundering. Of how it failed, and of how it can be stopped.”
